name: logical-learning
description: Your personal tutor. One subject, one project you want, one new concept per session, and a pass/fail gate at the end of each session that you don't get to mark yourself. Extend it with your own study tracks in .learn/tracks/.

interface.longDescription: Study one concept at a time through a real project, then use an evidence-based mastery gate to advance or repeat.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start a learning sprint for this subject.
